messages:
Sam R: NewCare Ops asked for a 75-min enablement to accelerate their migration from hosted -> dedicated and wanted a short agenda + runbook. Can we slot something mid-June?
Yuki N: They mentioned EMEA/APAC overlap, prefer 08:30-09:45 BST to catch both London and early APAC.
Carlos D: I can lead the Dedicated sizing and live smoke deploy. Free 2026-06-16 or 06-18 mornings.
Maya P: I'll cover security, compliance checklist, and the post-migration verification rubric. 06-16 is blocked for me but 06-18 works.
Sam R: Let's propose 2026-06-18 08:30-09:45 BST then. Keep it tight: 60min content + 15min Q&A and feedback.
cs_bot: Provisional event created: https://cal.example/event/2822223333 and poll: https://doodle.example/newcare-enable-2822.
Yuki N: Draft agenda (please trim if needed):

1) 08:30-08:40 Intro & success criteria (Sam)
2) 08:40-09:00 Dedicated sizing & autoscale patterns (Carlos)
3) 09:00-09:15 Live smoke deploy + sanity checks (Carlos)
4) 09:15-09:30 Security/KMS patterns & compliance checklist (Maya)
5) 09:30-09:45 Q&A, next steps, feedback form (Sam)

Carlos D: Two pre-work asks: (A) provide a tiny representative trace (3 requests) with token counts; (B) confirm whether they need private KMS. I'll prepare a short demo script.
Maya P: I'll draft the compliance checklist and a one-line readiness rubric we can attach to the wrap-up notes.
Sam R: Can cs_bot add a short feedback form (Likert + 1 open comment) and mark the event as "hands-on" in the description?
cs_bot: Added feedback form https://forms.example/newcare-feedback and updated description.
Yuki N: Suggest a 30-min dry-run with facilitators on 2026-06-17 09:00 BST to test the demo infra and any network/VPC access. Invite facilitators only.
Carlos D: Works for me. I'll also pre-stage a tiny model checkpoint and KV cache to speed the demo.
Maya P: I'll reserve "Enablement Hub" room in London in case someone joins locally and will post the room link in the event.
Sam R: I'll message the NewCare AM with the proposed date, agenda, pre-work, and poll link. Will update here once they confirm. Thanks team :thumbsup:
